experiment_data.hypothesis: ActAdd inference-time steering (adding d_syc direction to hidden states at target layers during generation) provides a training-free baseline for sycophancy reduction. If ActAdd ≈ DC-GRPO, training-time direction reward adds no value over simple inference steering; if DC-GRPO > ActAdd, the RL training process produces qualitatively different improvements that inference steering cannot achieve.

spec.notes: ActAdd inference-time steering baseline. Alpha sweep: [0.0, 0.5, 1.0, 2.0, 5.0]. Uses nli_utils.py for dynamic NLI label detection. Inference-only, no training.
